claim: Coverage of eligible businesses in the zone
problem: Only 9 of the 26 eligible independents my own searches turned up are in the list (about 35%, well under the 70% bar). The biggest hole is beauty/personal services: the list has no hair salon, barber or nail salon anywhere, though Fords has several on New Brunswick Ave and Lafayette Rd, and Hopelawn has one on New Brunswick Ave.
fix: Re-run the zone sweep for beauty/personal services and for independent electricians, roofers and landscapers before triage: Salon Dae, Jnshairstudio, Pro Hair, Franie's, Jazzy Nail Salon, Stars Nails, Nail Studio, Batista Place Beauty Salon, Lynn's Electric, Elite Roofing & Restoration, Kidd-Keller Construction, Ozzy and Son Landscaping, Priority Sewer & Water, Highland Grove Child Care, Alex Road Service, Racz's Towing.

claim: Excluded types retained: Best Western (1050 King Georges Post Rd)
problem: A Best Western is a franchise brand, which the mapper's own rules exclude. It was kept 'with a flag' because the property is locally owned - a rule change rather than a permitted exception. The entry also bundles Iconnect Hotels/Royal Albert's Palace at the same address.
fix: Drop the hotel entry, or get the franchise-hotel exception approved in writing before it goes to triage.

claim: Chris Andersen Roofing & Erecting Co., 95 New Brunswick Ave, Hopelawn
problem: Presented as an independent commercial roofer; the firm's current page says it is now part of Tecta America, a national roofing group. That makes it a chain-affiliated business, and the mapper's source (njccdirectory) predates the change.
fix: Remove, or flag explicitly as chain-owned (Tecta America) so no time is spent on it.

claim: Hatco Corp, 1020 King George Rd, Fords - 'commercial foodservice equipment manufacturer', described as a plant of a Wisconsin equipment maker
problem: Wrong business entirely. The Fords Hatco is a chemical company (LANXESS Solutions US Inc., doing business as Hatco Corporation), not the Milwaukee foodservice-equipment maker of the same name. Address and size call are also unverified.
fix: Correct the identity and category, or drop the entry - a chemical plant is not a fit for this list anyway.

claim: National/multi-site operators listed as prospects: Veseris, NFI Distribution, Alliance Shippers, Plastipak Packaging, Parlux Fragrances, Simple Human, US Beverage Packers
problem: Each is a branch or plant of a large corporate group; several are marked 'verify fit' in the notes but none is excluded. The brief excludes chains/franchises, and these are the same category of problem as the chains the mapper did exclude (Home Depot, Republic Services, etc.).
fix: Apply the chain rule consistently: drop the corporate branches and keep only locally owned operators in the industrial belt.

claim: C & D Foods, 43 New Brunswick Ave, Hopelawn - classed as 'commercial foodservice equipment repair'
problem: Its only source files it under both 'Asian Supermarkets' and commercial food-service equipment repair, and the trading name reads as a food business (an excluded type).
fix: Verify what the premises actually sells; drop it unless it is confirmed to be equipment service only.

claim: Most Valuable Plumber, 520 New Brunswick Ave, Fords
problem: No independent trace: Yellow Pages, Angi, BestProsInTown, BuildZoom and plumber directories for Fords do not carry this name. The only evidence is a single Google listing with one review.
fix: Leave out or re-check the map pin; a one-review listing with no phone is not a prospect.

claim: Integrity Remodeling & Repairs Inc - address '1 S Grant St', phone 'Unknown'
problem: Angi files the firm at 11 South Grant Street, Fords, with phone (973) 900-4576 and a 4.9 rating from 9 reviews. The street number and the missing phone are both wrong/incomplete.
fix: Update to 11 S Grant St and add (973) 900-4576 from Angi; note the number is a 973 area code.

claim: Fords Outdoor Power Equipment (Fords Lawn Mower & Tractor), 769 King Georges Rd
problem: The entry's own evidence says the map listing is marked temporarily closed; an entry kept with a 'temporarily closed' flag is not an operating business in the zone.
fix: Hold it out of the prospect list until the storefront is confirmed open.

claim: About 100 entries rest on us-business.info alone
problem: The Fords page of that directory currently renders a 'nothing at this address' header and only letters A-I, and no entry carries review activity. It is a real compilation (many entries do appear in it), but a single no-review scrape cannot establish that each shop is still trading.
fix: Tier these as 'unverified - single bulk directory' rather than prospects, and require one independent confirmation (state licence, own site, or map listing) before outreach.
